nodes.label: Encoded-Query Value Boundary Contract
nodes.rationale: Two halves must flip together: producer escapes values (safe minus ^); transport normalises assembled query. Producer safe-set is transport's minus caret so unquote-then-quote cannot resurrect structural characters.

nodes.label: Caret (^) Value Refusal
nodes.rationale: ServiceNow parser splits on decoded value; no encoding can carry ^ inside a value. Only options are refuse or restructure. ^OR remains caller-supplied structure exception.

nodes.label: Ampersand (&) Value Escape
nodes.rationale: & is not an encoded-query operator; it escaped sysparm_query into a sibling URL parameter, truncating conditions. Left transport safe-set; producer escapes and escaping survives.

nodes.label: ^NQ New-Query-Reset Refusal
nodes.rationale: Silent drop removed poisoned condition but still ran the rest, returning real-looking rows from an unasked query. Check must run at top of _build_query_condition and on _build_additional_filters path.

nodes.label: Structural vs Terminal Condition Handlers
nodes.rationale: Structural handlers return whole fragments and must not escape values but refuse &; terminal handlers paste values after field= and must encode_query_value. AST scan fails if a new terminal handler forgets.

nodes.label: Read-Failure Contract (ServiceNowRequestError)
nodes.rationale: Failed GET raises ServiceNowRequestError unconditionally — never None. Empty result is success; raise means read did not happen. Seven-code vocabulary: VALIDATION, NOT_FOUND, AUTH, FORBIDDEN, TIMEOUT, HTTP, INTERNAL.

nodes.label: Partial Read Keeps Rows
nodes.rationale: Mid-pagination failure returns collected rows plus partial:true and error; first-page failure is plain error. Filter emptying a partial result yields failure, not confident no-matches.

nodes.label: KB Publish Fail-Closed Duplicate Check
nodes.rationale: Three outcomes: clear / duplicates-found / inconclusive. Only clear permits publish. Previously failed check returned [] which publish treated as clear, so timeout published with guard skipped.

nodes.label: Domain Filtering Removal
nodes.rationale: Legacy category/catalog exclusions bought nothing for authorized-personnel-only server while making every query wider, slower, harder to reason about. Result sets get larger and noisier by design.

nodes.label: SLA Tool Consolidation (Sprint 2)
nodes.rationale: 8 SLA tools collapsed into 3; tool count 37→32. query_slas_by_status is preset dispatcher; query_slas_custom escape hatch defaults ESSENTIAL_FIELDS.

nodes.label: get_sla_details v3 Bug Fix
nodes.rationale: v3 used number={sys_id} on task_sla which has no number field; filter silently ignored, returned 10k rows (~1.2M tokens). v4 routes sys_id= for single record (~69 tokens).

nodes.label: GET Token-Optimization Invariants
nodes.rationale: GET applies display_value, exclude_reference_link, no_count, flattening; POST/PATCH/DELETE must bypass all — locked by three critical negative tests.

nodes.label: Intelligence–Builder Backref Discipline
nodes.rationale: filter/intelligence.py must not import builder. Auto-correction needing ServiceNowQueryBuilder lives only in filter/validator.validate_and_correct_filters — sole NL→construction bridge.

nodes.label: Pooled HTTP Client (oauth/http_pool.py)
nodes.rationale: Process-wide keep-alive httpx.AsyncClient shared by executor, 401-retry, and token fetch; previously every request paid a fresh TLS handshake.

nodes.label: OR-Combined LIKE Text Query
nodes.rationale: query_table_by_text builds one OR-combined LIKE query across keywords instead of serial per-keyword requests — fewer round-trips and better recall. CONTAINS is GlideRecord-only and silently ignored in sysparm_query.

nodes.label: SSE Transport Authentication
nodes.rationale: MCP_SSE_AUTH_TOKEN bearer check; startup refuses without it unless MCP_ALLOW_INSECURE_SSE. Rejection messages never reveal missing vs wrong token.

nodes.label: CMDB Probe Failure Semantics
nodes.rationale: Probe failure fails whole lookup rather than attributing CI to less-specific base table. Incomplete probe set supports neither not-found nor wrong-table attribution.

nodes.label: _has_operator_in_value Equals Limitation
nodes.rationale: Any = in a filter value treated as operator syntax so Cost=Center builds nonexistent field condition ServiceNow drops silently. Not encoding defect; pinned by test.

nodes.label: Azure Container Apps + Key Vault Hosting
nodes.rationale: Production stores credentials in Key Vault injected via managed identity secretRef — no secrets in env vars, shell history, or docker inspect.
nodes.norm_label: azure container apps + key vault hosting
